method.name: Image_PixMap
method.description: Empty constructor. Initialize the NULL image plane.

method.name: Format
method.description: Return pixel format.

method.name: SetFormat
method.description: Override pixel format specified by InitXXX() methods. Will throw exception if pixel size of new format is not equal to currently initialized format. Intended to switch formats indicating different interpretation of the same data (e.g. ImgGray and ImgAlpha).

method.name: Width
method.description: Return image width in pixels.

method.name: Height
method.description: Return image height in pixels.

method.name: Depth
method.description: Return image depth in pixels.

method.name: SizeX
method.description: Return image width in pixels.

method.name: SizeY
method.description: Return image height in pixels.

method.name: SizeZ
method.description: Return image depth in pixels.

method.name: Ratio
method.description: Return width / height.

method.name: IsEmpty
method.description: Return true if data is NULL.

method.name: PixelColor
method.description: Returns the pixel color. This function is relatively slow. Beware that this method takes coordinates in opposite order in contrast to ::Value() and ::ChangeValue().

method.name: SetPixelColor_1
method.description: Sets the pixel color. This function is relatively slow. Beware that this method takes coordinates in opposite order in contrast to ::Value() and ::ChangeValue().

method.name: SetPixelColor_2
method.description: Sets the pixel color. This function is relatively slow. Beware that this method takes coordinates in opposite order in contrast to ::Value() and ::ChangeValue().

method.name: InitTrash
method.description: Initialize image plane with required dimensions. Memory will be left uninitialized (performance trick).

method.name: InitCopy
method.description: Initialize by copying data. If you want to copy alien data you should create wrapper using InitWrapper() before.

method.name: Clear
method.description: Method correctly deallocate internal buffer.

method.name: IsTopDown
method.description: Returns TRUE if image data is stored from Top to the Down. By default Bottom Up order is used instead (topmost scanlines starts from the bottom in memory). which is most image frameworks naturally support.

method.name: SetTopDown
method.description: Setup scanlines order in memory - top-down or bottom-up. Drawers should explicitly specify this value if current state IsTopDown() was ignored!

method.name: TopDownInc
method.description: Returns +1 if scanlines ordered in Top->Down order in memory and -1 otherwise.

method.name: SizePixelBytes_1
method.description: Return bytes reserved for one pixel (may include extra bytes for alignment).

method.name: SizeRowBytes
method.description: Return bytes reserved per row. Could be larger than needed to store packed row (extra bytes for alignment etc.).

method.name: RowExtraBytes
method.description: Return the extra bytes in the row.

method.name: MaxRowAligmentBytes
method.description: Compute the maximal row alignment for current row size.

method.name: SizeSliceBytes
method.description: Return number of bytes per 2D slice.

method.name: SizeBytes
method.description: Return buffer size

method.name: IsBigEndianHost
method.description: Determine Big-Endian at runtime

method.name: SizePixelBytes_2
method.description: Return bytes reserved for one pixel (may include extra bytes for alignment).

method.name: SwapRgbaBgra
method.description: Auxiliary method for swapping bytes between RGB and BGR formats. This method modifies the image data but does not change pixel format! Method will fail if pixel format is not one of the following: - Image_Format_RGB32 / Image_Format_BGR32 - Image_Format_RGBA / Image_Format_BGRA - Image_Format_RGB / Image_Format_BGR - Image_Format_RGBF / Image_Format_BGRF - Image_Format_RGBAF / Image_Format_BGRAF

method.name: ToBlackWhite
method.description: Convert image to Black/White.

method.name: FlipY
method.description: Reverse line order as it draws it from bottom to top.

method.name: DefaultAllocator
method.description: Return default image data allocator.

method.name: ImageFormatToString_1
method.description: Return string representation of pixel format.

method.name: ImageFormatToString_2
method.description: Return string representation of compressed pixel format.

method.name: ConvertFromHalfFloat
method.description: Convert 16-bit half-float value into 32-bit float (simple conversion).

method.name: ConvertToHalfFloat
method.description: Convert 32-bit float value into IEEE-754 16-bit floating-point format without infinity: 1-5-10, exp-15, +-131008.0, +-6.1035156E-5, +-5.9604645E-8, 3.311 digits.
